note_replay_rates: N=200 efficiency-subset replay rate and N=1145 full-validation replay rate are reported separately and must never be conflated.
fallback_note: Both AGIR and DINO-always fall back to attribution-based localization when Grounding DINO returns no box. This is the frozen canonical fallback rule, documented here rather than described as pure DINO timing.
gate_model_latency_note: gate_model_latency is CPU-side LogisticRegression inference on a scaled scalar, measured separately from confidence_latency (the GPU forward pass computing the log-likelihood). Both are included in agir_total_latency.
